- **Output:** `/Users/dev/terminal-bench/cwe-bench/stacking/out/screener/18405.json`. I re-opened the cited lines and they say what the file claims.
- **Trust decision:** this is about who may read the live stream of replicated SQL on vttablet. The `/debug/vrlog` handler (`go/vt/vttablet/tabletmanager/vreplication/vrlog.go:71-77`) has no `acl.CheckAccessHTTP(DEBUGGING)` check, which every neighbouring debug page has. The published fix deletes the whole feature rather than adding the check.
- **`pattern_fit`:** `injection_only`. The 13 changed sites are just what deleting the feature touches, not 13 routes in. There is one route, no out-of-scope site, and I found no uncovered route that exposes the same data.
- **Strongest lever:** a sibling we would add ourselves: a per-workflow config key in `NewVReplicationConfig` (`go/vt/vttablet/common/config.go:249`) that lets whoever creates a workflow turn the log on. Every other VReplication flag already has such a key, so it would look natural.
- **Biggest red flag:** `single_site`. Adding the one ACL check to the handler fully fixes it in about 10 minutes, so no model is likely to fail on scope.
